tool_args.title: Narendra Modi: Biography and Political Overview
tool_args.content: Narendra Damodardas Modi (born 17 September 1950) is an Indian politician serving as the 14th Prime Minister of India since May 2014. He was the Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014 and is the Member of Parliament for Varanasi. Modi is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), a right-wing Hindu nationalist paramilitary volunteer organisation. He is the longest-serving prime minister in Indian history. Key policy initiatives during his tenure include the 'Make in India' campaign, the implementation of the Goods and Services Tax (GST), the demonetisation of high-denomination banknotes in 2016, and the Digital India initiative. His leadership style is often characterized by a strong focus on infrastructure development, digital transformation, and assertive foreign policy.
